Casanova-Acebes 2021 establishes the pro-tumorigenic niche role of alveolar TRMs in early NSCLC: spatial localization, transcriptional reprogramming, EMT induction, Treg licensing, CD169-DTR depletion phenotype, temporal restriction.

First explicit demonstration that TRMs (not BMMs/MDMs) selectively induce EMT in NSCLC tumor cells via reduced E-cadherin, TWIST1/ZEB1 induction, and invasive protrusions in 3D Matrigel co-culture; tTRM-CM sufficient for migration.
First explicit demonstration of TRM-selective Treg licensing (CD73/CTLA-4 enhancement) in cancer; CD169-DTR depletion validates lineage specificity; spatial Treg-TRM co-localization in tumor lesions.

Applies Map17(Pdzk1ip1)-creER and Cx3cr1-creER fate mapping in NSCLC to assign group I (PPARG/MARCO/SIGLEC1) to TRM lineage and group II (TREM2/SPP1/APOE) to MDM lineage; cross-species conservation between human and mouse.
Identifies TREM2/SPP1/APOE/GPNMB as the canonical 'group II' MDM TAM signature in NSCLC, matching the MoMac-VERSE TREM2_Mac cluster #3 framework.
TRM-Treg axis is a parallel immunosuppressive mechanism alongside TREM2/IL4I1 TAM programs; relevant to general TAM-immunosuppression framework.

Casanova-Acebes 2021 (NSCLC-specific in vivo TRM-MDM dichotomy with mechanistic CD169-DTR causal evidence) is complementary to Mulder 2021 MoMac-VERSE (pan-tissue/pan-cancer scRNA-seq atlas of MNP states); the NSCLC group I = TRM aligns with embryonic-leaning MoMac-VERSE clusters and group II = MDM/TREM2 aligns with TREM2_Mac cluster #3.

Casanova-Acebes 2021 (TRM-driven NSCLC niche, lineage-specific) is complementary to Calafell 2024 (NF-kB/TET2-driven hypoxic monocyte-derived macrophage reprogramming): both papers contribute to the macrophage state-vs-ontogeny framework that the user's thesis builds on; mMAC1 maps to MDM territory (group II) downstream of the TRM-MDM dichotomy this paper establishes.

Casanova-Acebes 2021 independently identifies TREM2/SPP1/APOE/GPNMB as the MDM (group II) signature in mouse and human NSCLC, with cross-species conservation, consistent with pan-cancer TREM2_Mac accumulation reported by Mulder 2021 MoMac-VERSE.
